ctx.x: I'll tell you another good trumpet player, he played Dixieland too. He used to play with, I can't think of that man's name right now, he used to play with Pichon, when we were working with Pichon. From here? Yeah, he lived uptown. He and Louis, to me, he's a very good friend. He's got with Gaudet. Gaudet, that's right.
We had a boy here playing just like Gaudet, just coming, well anyhow him, he'd been sick in the hospital and he's out now, Joe Bentley.
